p.i: Act.22. v.16. Baptizare & ablue peccata tua.
i.Corinth.11. v.24. Hoc meum est corpus quodpro vobis frangitur.
Luc.22. v.20, Hoc poculum est nouum illud testamentum per meum sanguinem, qui pro vobis effunditur.

main_text.l: c) exhibentia rem significatam in legitimo vsu.
f) prædicentia resurrectionem carnis, & vitam æternam.
b) Rom.4.verf.11.Et signum accepit circumcisionis,(Abraham)sigillum iustitiæ fidei. 15
main_text.p: c) Matth.26.v.26.27.28. Accipite, comedite:Hoc est corpus meum. Item: Bibite ex eo omnes. Hoc est enim sanguis meus noui fœderis, qui pro multis effunditur in remissionem peccatorum.

p.i: d) Gen.17. v.14. Præputiatus autem mas, qui non circumciderit carnem præputij sui, vtique exscindetur homo ille è popu-lis suis.
f) Rom. 6. v.4. Sepulti sumus igitur cum eo per baptismum in mortem : vt sicut suscitatus est Christus ex mortuis in gloriam Patris, ita & nos nouâ vitâ incedamus.

main_text.p: 4. In sacramentis vniuntur res terrestris & cœle-stis vi promissionis Christi vera fide appre-hensæ. 30
Et v.28. Hoc est sanguis meus. Sic Marcii14.v.22.24. Lucæ 22.v.19.20.1.Cor.10.v.4.&6.1.Cor.11.v.24.25.

page.notes: Left-margin numbers 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are printed line markers and are transcribed as notes at their lines. Stray marks at the far left edge belong to the neighbouring page and are omitted. Doubtful readings: "Marcii14" may be "Marci14"; "quodpro" is printed without a space and is left as printed. Printed text includes long s, which is rendered as s. The "s" sign at the start of the Luc.22 line appears to be a printed continuation mark and is not transcribed. Pinpoint references such as "num.2." are read from a small figure and may be doubtful.
